title: Target leakage wins competitions and fails Mondays
body: A feature computed using information only available after the outcome, like a discharge code predicting readmission, gives glorious validation scores and a useless model. Leakage is the most common way ML projects lie to themselves, because every metric applauds. The defence is boring: timestamp every feature and ask 'would I know this at prediction time'.
source_hint: Kaufman et al. on leakage in data mining (2012)
